notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Lightning-Rig Crew.
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat until you have two or less opponents remaining.
